title: Final Integrated Evidence Synthesis & Closure
purpose: Perform the final read-only integration of completed T9 evidence and close the T9 empirical confidence/calibration boundary.

final_evidence_statement.T2: No accepted native probability artifact for probability calibration.
final_evidence_statement.T3: No accepted native probability artifact for probability calibration.
final_evidence_statement.T4: Native candidate-space ranking evaluation is established. Universal probability calibration is not established.
final_evidence_statement.T5: Empirical calibration improvement evidence is established. No formal calibration method winner was selected.
final_evidence_statement.T6: Native query-level retrieval/ranking evaluation and reliability evidence are established. Ordinary binary probability calibration is not established.
final_evidence_statement.T7: Native survival evaluation, uncertainty, and descriptive reliability are established. Formal survival calibration and formal calibration uncertainty are not established.
final_evidence_statement.cross_task: Task-specific quantities cannot be treated as numerically comparable probabilities. No universal confidence/risk construct is empirically established or created.

closure.scope: T9 confidence, calibration, native evaluation, uncertainty, reliability, and cross-task evidence boundary.
closure.empirical_boundary: T9 establishes task-specific empirical evidence only. Heterogeneous task outputs remain tied to their native predictive quantities and observation structures.
closure.calibration_boundary: T5 has empirical calibration improvement evidence without formal method selection. T2 and T3 lack accepted native probability artifacts. T4 and T6 remain native ranking/retrieval quantities. T7 remains a survival quantity with censoring-aware uncertainty.
closure.cross_task_boundary: Cross-task numerical probability comparability is not established and is prohibited by the frozen methodology.
closure.final_interpretation: T9 is closed as an evidence and calibration boundary. It does not create a universal confidence/risk score or an autonomous decision policy. The resulting T8 interface remains task-specific, provenance-preserving, and uncertainty-aware.

methodological_restrictions: T6 observable_non_positive is not treated as a true negative.
